3111983.findings: Colonial-style rustic farmhouse kitchen table: single-board style rectangular top with rounded corners and moulded edge, plain apron (no drawer visible), four turned legs with ring turnings. Base retains old dark paint/grime, untouched patina. Top shows a pronounced open grain more like Baltic pine or Oregon than typical fine-grained kauri, so the 'kauri' claim is not clearly supported. No maker's marks, labels or stamps visible. Size 157 x 84 cm is a useful dining/kitchen size; untouched primitive tables of this type sell to the decorator market and typically make $250-500 in Australia.
3111983.condition: Heavy wear and staining to the top (dark water marks, red stain, scratches), apron has split/cracked paint and a loose or patched board on one side, old paint flaking on legs, leg feet worn. Appears structurally complete; would need cleaning or restoration.
3111983.reason: Untouched rustic colonial pine farmhouse table with turned legs, a type that regularly resells for $250-500 to the decorator market.
